statement: The grid is a list of equal-length strings in which '#' marks a stone and '.' marks empty ground. Two stones belong to the same cluster when they are connected through a chain of stones, where consecutive stones share an edge (up, down, left or right; diagonal neighbours do not connect). Return the number of clusters. Return 0 when the grid is empty or contains no stone. The grid is a list of strings that all have the same length; the list may be empty, and its rows may be empty strings.
